challenges.name: Caesar's Last Message
challenges.hint: Try shifting every letter by the same amount.
challenges.solution: Apply a Caesar shift of -7.

challenges.name: Base64 Isn't Encryption
challenges.hint: Base64 text often ends in =. Decode repeatedly.
challenges.solution: Base64-decode twice.

challenges.name: The Broken Cipher
challenges.hint: It is a repeating-key classical cipher; the direction is NORTH.
challenges.solution: Vigenere-decrypt with key NORTH.

challenges.name: RSA's Little Mistake
challenges.hint: 3233 factors into two small primes. Calculate d, then m = c^d mod n.
challenges.solution: Factor n=61*53; d=2753; decrypt c=2790 to 65, then Caesar-decrypt the supplied text by 65.

challenges.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
challenges.hint: Browsers receive more than they render.
challenges.solution: View page source and read the HTML comment.

challenges.name: Cookie Monster
challenges.hint: Cookies live on the client. Inspect and decode the role value.
challenges.solution: Change the Base64 role cookie from user to admin (YWRtaW4=), then reload.

challenges.name: The Weak Login
challenges.hint: What happens when a quote changes a login query? Try the conventional admin comment payload.
challenges.solution: Submit username admin' -- (URL-encoded by browser) with any password. This is a simulation only; no DB is present.

challenges.name: The Forgotten Endpoint
challenges.hint: Sites sometimes tell crawlers where not to look.
challenges.solution: Read /robots.txt and browse to /archive/.

challenges.name: What's in the Image?
challenges.hint: Inspect PNG text chunks or metadata.
challenges.solution: Use strings, exiftool, or a PNG chunk viewer.

challenges.name: Metadata
challenges.hint: Ask the file what it says about itself.
challenges.solution: Run strings or metadata tooling and read the Comment field.

challenges.name: Packet Hunt
challenges.hint: Follow UDP payloads; display filters can help.
challenges.solution: Open in Wireshark and inspect UDP packet data.

challenges.name: Deleted Evidence
challenges.hint: Not every useful file has a friendly name.
challenges.solution: List archive contents including hidden-looking paths, then read recovered/.evidence.txt.

challenges.name: Find the Place
challenges.hint: Coordinates identify a city. This event uses fictional/offline evidence only.
challenges.solution: Map the coordinates 41.40338, 2.17403 to Barcelona; flag is supplied in source as validation.

challenges.name: Digital Footprints
challenges.hint: Archived profile details are clues; inspect source too.
challenges.solution: Read the provided fictional archive and its source.

challenges.name: The Missing Developer
challenges.hint: Contributor records, commit logs, and remotes form a trail.
challenges.solution: Extract archive and correlate the fictional contributor information.

challenges.name: The Final Connection
challenges.hint: Combine the codename and launch window from separate records.
challenges.solution: Extract and combine ORBIT with BLUE-7.

challenges.name: Strings Don't Lie
challenges.hint: Start with strings. The supplied file is Python bytecode.
challenges.solution: Run strings on the pyc or decompile it.

challenges.name: Crack the Code
challenges.hint: The program compares a transformed input. XOR is its own inverse.
challenges.solution: Decompile or extract TARGET/KEY and XOR each target byte with 117.

challenges.name: The Strange File
challenges.hint: Trust file signatures, not extensions. You may have two layers to unwrap.
challenges.solution: Identify gzip magic bytes, decompress, then Base64-decode.

challenges.name: Think Outside the Box
challenges.hint: A container can contain another container.
challenges.solution: Extract the outer ZIP, then box/another_box.zip.

challenges.name: ROT13 Rendezvous
challenges.hint: Try a Caesar shift where the alphabet wraps halfway around.
challenges.solution: Apply ROT13 to the provided message.

challenges.name: Hexed Message
challenges.hint: Look at the characters: 0-9 and A-F are a clue.
challenges.solution: Convert the hex string to ASCII.

challenges.name: Binary Whisper
challenges.hint: Eight bits can represent one character.
challenges.solution: Convert binary to ASCII.

challenges.name: Inspect Me
challenges.hint: The browser shows more than what you see.
challenges.solution: View page source and read the HTML comment.

challenges.name: The Secret Parameter
challenges.hint: Sometimes the URL controls more than the page.
challenges.solution: Add ?debug=true to the URL to see the flag.

challenges.name: Case Sensitive
challenges.hint: JavaScript can reveal what the server forgot to hide.
challenges.solution: Inspect the JavaScript for credentials and log in.

challenges.name: Hidden in the Filename
challenges.hint: Sometimes the file tells you more about itself than its contents do.
challenges.solution: Notice the flag in the filename.

challenges.name: Echo in the Text
challenges.hint: Search through the evidence.
challenges.solution: Grep the file for the flag line.

challenges.name: Double Extension
challenges.hint: Don't always trust the extension.
challenges.solution: Use file command to see true type and read the comment chunk.

challenges.name: The Username Trail
challenges.hint: A username can appear in more than one place.
challenges.solution: Correlate the clues to discover the username and derive the flag.

challenges.name: Read the Strings
challenges.hint: Before reversing everything, look at what the program says.
challenges.solution: Run strings on the bytecode to find the flag.

challenges.name: Three Layers
challenges.hint: One encoding is rarely the whole story.
challenges.solution: Decode Base64 → Hex → Base64 to reveal the flag.
